hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\brm\b.*data/raw|\bmv\b.*data/raw|\bcp\b.+[[:space:]]+data/raw/|\btruncate\b.*data/raw|\bdd\b.*of=data/raw|>[[:space:]]*data/raw'; then echo "BLOCKED: This command would delete, move, or overwrite files in data/raw/. Raw data is read-only — copy files out to a working directory before modifying them." >&2; python3 -c "import json; print(json.dumps({'systemMessage':'Blocked: command targets data/raw/ — raw data is read-only.','hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','permissionDecision':'deny','permissionDecisionReason':'Command would delete, move, or overwrite files in data/raw/ — raw data is read-only and must not be modified.'}}))"; fi
